run_multiplex_client: run the gRPC multiplex client that makes Greeter and RouteGuide RPCs to localhost:50051
guide_get_feature: query a RouteGuide stub to get feature details at specific latitude and longitude coordinates
guide_list_features: list all features within a geographic rectangle using the RouteGuide server-streaming RPC
guide_record_route: record a random route via client-streaming RPC and print trip summary with points and distance
guide_route_chat: send and receive RouteNote messages via the RouteGuide bidirectional streaming RouteChat RPC
